description: Background jobs, pub/sub messages, in-process requests and streams for .NET 10, stored in your PostgreSQL or SQL Server database through EF Core. Transactional outbox, no broker, real-time dashboard.
rules: NuGet package ids are Moberg.Warp.*; namespaces are Warp.*. Use the same version for every package.
Register with AddWarpServer<TContext> in a process that runs jobs and AddWarp<TContext> in one that only publishes. AddWarpWorker was removed.
Call opt.UsePostgreSql() or opt.UseSqlServer(); a provider package is required.
Publish through IPublisher, then call SaveChangesAsync on the same DbContext so the job commits with the data.
Do not register handlers by hand; a source generator finds IJobHandler<T>, IMessageHandler<T>, IRequestHandler<T, TResponse> and IStreamRequestHandler<T, TResponse>.
Register AddRetry() before AddTimeout(), and AddConcurrency() before AddRateLimit().
Enums in Warp start at 1; do not rely on default(T).
